items.title: AI資安業者Alice募資1.4億美元，AI業務兩年成長逾500%
items.summary: AI資安業者Alice近日完成1.4億美元募資，由Apax Digital Funds領投，累計募資金額達2.8億美元。隨著企業與AI模型業者對AI安全的需求增加，Alice表示，公司AI相關業務過去兩年成長超過500%，年度經常性收入（Annual Recurring Revenue，ARR）已接近1億美元。 Alice前身為ActiveFence，最初主要提供網路平臺信任與安全相關服務，長期追蹤詐騙、極端主義內容及協同操弄等網路濫用活動，近年則將這些威脅資料運用於AI安全領域。Alice合作的AI模型開發業者包括Anthropic、Google及Cohere等。

items.title: 恩智浦推出MCX A5 MCU，為工業與IoT邊緣裝置導入PQC防護
items.summary: 恩智浦半導體（NXP）8月18日發表MCX A5系列微控制器（MCU），鎖定工業自動化、建築自動化及IoT邊緣裝置等應用，透過整合10BASE-T1S乙太網路數位PHY，讓感測器、控制器等設備更容易連接IP網路，同時結合多項安全防護功能，強化工業設備與邊緣裝置的連線安全，目前已開始提供樣品。

items.title: 逾270臺郵件伺服器Zimbra遭SNMP通知元件漏洞入侵
items.summary: 8月下旬波蘭電腦緊急應變團隊CERT Polska、美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）提出警告，Zimbra於7月修補的遠端程式碼執行（RCE）漏洞CVE-2026-73570，已遭到積極利用。此弱點存在於安裝選用套件zimbra-snmp並啟用SNMP通知的Zimbra系統，未經身分驗證的攻擊者可發送特製SMTP請求觸發，CVSS嚴重程度評分為8.9。

items.title: CI/CD平臺TeamCity重大漏洞被用於攻擊澳洲組織
items.summary: 開發工具供應商JetBrains於7月底，修補CI/CD平臺TeamCity重大等級的資安漏洞CVE-2026-63077（CVSS嚴重程度評為9.8分），一週後美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）警告已遭到利用，本週有其他國家發生攻擊活動。

items.title: Visual Studio 2026擴充Git多分支開發，Copilot可依任務調整推理強度
items.summary: 微軟Visual Studio 2026八月更新釋出18.9版本，加入Git工作樹與子模組管理，開發者可在同一個Git儲存庫建立多個獨立工作目錄，並同時處理不同分支，也能直接管理專案引用的其他Git儲存庫。GitHub Copilot則新增模型思考強度設定，可依工作複雜度選擇低、中、高三種等級，調整推理深度、回應速度與權杖（token）用量。

items.title: 蘋果同步改款Mac mini與Mac Studio，打造專為AI而生的桌機陣容
items.summary: 蘋果週二（8/25）同步更新Mac mini與Mac Studio，兩款產品的改版均以強化AI效能為核心訴求。

items.title: fix(reply): prevent private prompt context leaking into delivered rep…
items.summary: fix(reply): prevent private prompt context leaking into delivered replies (#115745) * fix(reply): redact private prompt context before delivery Protect final and streaming replies from exact copied inbound prompts, including same-line, fenced, quoted, and partial streaming variants. Preserve safe literal examples and suppress empty exec-output placeholders. Fixes #78177. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * test(telegram): own reply privacy delivery integration Move real Telegram HTTP privacy regressions into the plugin-owned test graph and drive finalized inbound dispatch through the public SDK. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * fix(reply): redact multiline quoted private prompt context Recognize standard, indented, and nested Markdown blockquotes in final replies and withhold every incremental quoted streaming prefix before private history can reach Telegram. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * fix(reply): redact decorated private prompt streams Match exact prompt-owned Markdown formatting per line and withhold every streamed prefix, including headings, indented code, list continuations, mixed wrappers, repeated markers, and safe same-line text. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * fix(reply): redact carriage-return prompt copies Accept every source-normalized line-ending variant before private context reaches final replies, streaming, or Telegram delivery. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * fix(reply): bound streamed private prompt candidate scans Reject non-marker candidates before allocating suffixes and fail closed on repeated verified marker floods to prevent quadratic streaming work. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 * fix(reply): keep prompt-line character extraction type-safe Use the canonical non-empty source-line character once so strict core, test, lint, and plugin boundary compilers agree without changing privacy behavior. Co-authored-by: SnowSky1 --------- Co-authored-by: SnowSky1
